description.content: Retrieves AI powered product discovery suggestions based on conversational free-form text. Returns results in small batches using a real time [Server-sent Events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events) stream for a dynamic user experience.
